population.text: Patients with Stage IIIc or Stage IV cutaneous melanoma, BRAF V600E/K mutation-positive, with no more than one prior chemotherapy regimen

citations.quote: Key eligibility criteria were a diagnosis of Stage IIIc or Stage IV cutaneous melanoma, BRAF V600E/K mutation-positive tumor as determined with the “GSK BRAF mutation assay,” no more than one prior regimen for treatment of unresectabl

The primary objective was to demonstrate superior progression-free survival (PFS) as determined by the investigator, with trametinib as compared to chemotherapy in patients with V600E/K locally advanced or metastatic melanoma.

n.text: 322 patients randomized; trametinib n=214, chemotherapy n=108

citations.quote: A total of 322 patients were enrolled and randomized to trametinib (n=214) or chemotherapy (n=108).

result.text: Median PFS 4.8 months (trametinib) vs 1.5 months (chemotherapy); HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.34, 0.65); p<0.0001. Overall response rate 22% vs 8%.

citations.quote: The trial demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in the PFS for the trametinib arm compared with chemotherapy [HR 0.47 (95% confidence intervals (CI): 0.34, 0.65)] with an increase in median PFS from 1.5 months in the chemotherapy arm to a median PFS of 4.8 months for the trametinib arm.

indication.text: Treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test. Limitation of use: not indicated for patients who have received prior BRAF inhibitor therapy.

citations.quote: MEKINIST is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test. (1)
**Limitation of use:** MEKINIST is not indicated for the treatment of patients who have received prior BRAF inhibitor therapy. (1)

target_moa.text: Trametinib is a selective, non-competitive inhibitor of MEK1 and MEK2 activation and kinase activity, including inhibition mediated by constitutively activated BRAF in BRAF mutation-positive cells.

citations.quote: Trametinib (Mekinist, GlaxoSmithKline), also known as GSK1120212, is a selective, non-competitive inhibitor of MEK1/MEK2 activation and kinase activity.

The NDA contained in vitro pharmacology studies demonstrating inhibition of MEK1/MEK2 kinase activity directly as well as that mediated by constitutively activated BRAF in BRAF B600E mutation-positive cells

detail.text: Approved first cycle; no prior CRL stated. Approved effective on the date of the approval letter, against a PDUFA goal date of June 3, 2013.

requirement.text: 2045-1 Cardiomyopathy: Submit cumulative safety analyses annually (and for one year after last patient completes treatment) to characterize the risk of cardiomyopathy in ongoing/subsequent randomized controlled trials using Mekinist through 2020.

citations.quote: Submit cumulative safety analyses annually, and for one year after the last patient has completed clinical trial treatment, to identify and characterize the risk of cardiomyopathy and subsequent sequelae, including safety evaluations adequate to inform labeling of patient populations at highest risk for developing these toxicities and to provide evidence-based dose modification and monitoring recommendations, in all ongoing and subsequently initiated randomized controlled clinical trials through 2020 that use Mekinist (trametinib) alone or in combination with other anti-cancer drugs.
## 2045-1 **Cardiomyopathy**

requirement.text: 2045-2 Ocular Toxicity: Submit integrated safety analyses from randomized controlled trials to characterize the risk of retinal pigmented epithelial detachments (RPED).

citations.quote: Submit integrated safety analyses from an adequate number of randomized controlled clinical trial(s) using Mekinist (trametinib) to identify and characterize the risk of retinal pigmented epithelial detachments (RPED), including safety evaluations adequate to inform labeling of patient populations at highest risk and to provide evidence-based dose modification and monitoring recommendations in labeling of RPED events.
## 2045-2 **Ocular Toxicity**

requirement.text: 2045-3 Hepatic Impairment Pharmacokinetic Trial: Conduct a PK trial to determine the appropriate dose of Mekinist in patients with hepatic impairment.

summary.text: Trametinib was granted orphan drug designation (Dec 2010) and Fast Track designation (June 2012) for BRAF V600-mutant melanoma; the application underwent standard (regular) review after the applicant withdrew its priority review request, and was granted regular (full) approval based on the single Phase III trial MEK114267, not accelerated approval.

citations.quote: December 20, 2010: GlaxoSmithKline received orphan drug designation for (b) (4)

June 29, 2012: FDA granted Fast Track designation for the development program for the development program the investigation of “trametinib (GSK1120212)” for the treatment of patients with BRAFv600k mutation-positive, unresectable or metastatic melanoma to demonstrate improved progression-free survival.
The applicant withdrew the priority review request voluntarily.

In this New Drug Application (NDA), the applicant was seeking regular approval of Mekinist ® (trametinib, formerly GSK1120212 and JTP-74057), a kinase inhibitor, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test indicated for this use, who have not received BRAF inhibitor therapy.

description.text: Added trametinib in combination with dabrafenib for unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations (accelerated approval)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes to include a new indication for Mekinist (trametinib), in combination with dabrafenib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test. This indication is based on the demonstration of durable response rate. Improvement in disease-related symptoms or overall survival has not been demonstrated for MEKINIST in combination with dabrafenib.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to regular approval for trametinib in combination with dabrafenib for unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application provides regular approval of trametinib, in combination with dabrafenib, for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test and to remove the statement from the currently approved indication “This indication is based on the demonstration of durable response rate [see Clinical Studies (14.1)]. Improvement in disease-related symptoms or overall survival has not been demonstrated for MEKINIST in combination with dabrafenib.”

description.text: Added new indication for trametinib in combination with dabrafenib for metastatic NSCLC with BRAF V600E mutation

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for Mekinist, in combination with dabrafenib, for the treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with BRAF V600E mutation as detected by an FDA-approved test.

description.text: Added new indication: trametinib in combination with dabrafenib for adjuvant treatment of melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations and lymph node involvement following complete resection

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for MEKINIST in combination with dabrafenib, for the adjuvant treatment of patients with melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations as detected by an FDA-approved test, and pathologic involvement of lymph node(s), following complete resection.

description.text: Added MEKINIST (trametinib) in combination with dabrafenib for locally advanced or metastatic anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) with BRAF V600E mutation and no satisfactory locoregional treatment options

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for MEKINIST in combination with dabrafenib, for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) with BRAF V600E mutation and with no satisfactory locoregional treatment options.

description.text: Added COMBI-MB study results for dabrafenib plus trametinib in BRAF mutation-positive melanoma metastatic to the brain in Clinical Studies section

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for updates to the CLINICAL STUDIES (14.2) section in the MEKINIST United States Prescribing Information (USPI) adding the results of Study BRF117277 (Novartis study code CDRB436B2204; "the COMBI-MB study"), a non-randomized, open-label, multi-center, multi-cohort trial of dabrafenib plus trametinib in subjects with BRAF mutation-positive melanoma that has metastasized to the brain.

description.text: Updated the BRAF V600E-positive anaplastic thyroid cancer clinical studies section with revised efficacy data (no new indication)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application revises the CLINICAL STUDIES, BRAF V600E Mutation-Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer (14.4) subsection with updated patient characteristics, overall response rate, and duration of response data.

description.text: Updated CLINICAL STUDIES section with additional follow-up for duration of response and overall response rate in BRAF V600E mutation-positive metastatic NSCLC; no new indication added

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application revises the CLINICAL STUDIES, BRAFT V600E Mutation-Positive Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (14.3) subsection with additional follow-up for duration of response (DOR) in patients who received dabrafenib as a single agent or trametinib in combination with dabrafenib and were considered responders in Study BRF113928 at the time of the initial approval. Additionally, the overall response rate (ORR) results and categorizations of best overall response were updated for patients who were previously treated and received trametinib in combination with dabrafenib. Similarly, the categorizations of best overall response were updated for patients who were treatment-naive prior to receiving trametinib in combination with dabrafenib.

description.text: Added tissue-agnostic accelerated approval for trametinib with dabrafenib in adult and pediatric patients 6 years and older with unresectable or metastatic solid tumors with BRAF V600E mutation progressing after prior treatment

citations.quote: *MEKINIST in combination with dabrafenib is indicated for the treatment of adult and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older with unresectable or metastatic solid tumors with BRAF V600E mutation who have progressed following prior treatment and have no satisfactory alternative treatment options. This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on overall response rate and duration of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s).*

description.text: Added treatment of pediatric patients 1 year and older with low-grade glioma with a BRAF V600E mutation who require systemic therapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for the use of Mekinist (trametinib) tablets for the treatment of pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with low-grade glioma with a BRAF V600E mutation who require systemic therapy.

description.text: Extended the tumor agnostic indication age range from patients 6 years and older to patients 1 year and older

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides updates to the Mekinist (trametinib) Prescribing Information (PI) and the Patient Package Insert extending the age range of the tumor agnostic indication from patients aged 6 years of age and older to patients aged 1 year of age and older.

description.text: Added overall survival data from COMBI-AD (Study CDRB436F2301) for adjuvant treatment of BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma to the Clinical Studies section

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for updates to Clinical Studies Section 14 of the Mekinist (trametinib) U.S. Prescribing Information (USPI) with the addition of overall survival data from Study CDRB436F2301, entitled "A Phase III Randomized Double-Blind Study of Dabrafenib in COMBINATION with Trametinib Versus Two Placebos in the Adjuvant Treatment of High-Risk BRAF V600 Mutation-Positive Melanoma After Surgical Resection (COMBI-AD)," associated with Postmarketing commitment PMC 3377-1. This supplemental application also includes other related edits, as well as minor editorial updates.
